letters.title: Welcome to the city
letters.text: I found you a place, Old. It's small and the boiler makes noises, but it's yours. I've paid the first three months — after that you're on your own. Make me proud. — Nelu

letters.title: Flat 304
letters.text: Rent is €65 a month plus electricity. It is covered until the end of October. From then on the bill arrives here at the start of every month. Lights left on cost money.
